name: filascribe
description: NFC filament tag writer: create, read and update filament spool tags from a web page or an Android app.
author: Rrrrobert

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:readers && playwright test
scripts.test:readers: tests/compat/fetch-readers.sh .readers && node tests/compat/make-fixtures.js tests/compat/out && FIRMWARE_DIR=.readers/firmware OPENRFID_DIR=.readers/openrfid FIXTURES_DIR=tests/compat/out python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/compat
